title: Telegram bot
text: CRM notifications in Telegram: new leads, meetings, payments, tasks and reports.
notConfigured: The bot is not configured on the server yet. The CEO needs to set TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN (see README, section “Telegram bot”).
step1: 1. Open the bot and tap “Start” — the code will be filled in automatically.
step2: Or send this command to the bot manually:
expires: The code is valid for 15 minutes and can be used once. The page will refresh automatically once connected.
testSent: Message queued — it will arrive within a minute
settingsText: Choose which notifications to receive in the CRM and in Telegram.

errors.notConfigured: The Telegram bot is not configured: the CEO needs to set TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN on the server
errors.noUsername: Couldn’t get the bot name. Set TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME
errors.network: No connection to Telegram: {error}. Will retry automatically

problems.badToken: The bot token is invalid (it may have been replaced in @BotFather). Set the current TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN in .env
problems.conflict: The bot receives messages elsewhere: another webhook is set, or another server is using this token
problems.network: The server cannot connect to Telegram ({reason}). Check that the hosting can reach api.telegram.org
problems.usernameMismatch: TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME (@{configured}) does not match the bot that owns the token (@{bot}). Fix .env or remove TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME
problems.noWebhook: Webhook is not set: run php artisan fluggi:telegram-webhook on the server
problems.otherWebhook: The bot webhook points to a different URL ({url}): run php artisan fluggi:telegram-webhook
problems.webhookError: Telegram cannot deliver messages to the server: {error}
problems.stale: The bot hasn’t been checked for more than 15 minutes: background jobs are not running. Set up the cron “php artisan schedule:run” every minute (or POST /hooks/cron) and run php artisan fluggi:telegram-webhook

botReplies.invalidCode: The code is invalid or expired. Get a new one in your CRM profile: “Connect Telegram”.
botReplies.linked: ✅ Telegram is connected to {app}. {name}, notifications will arrive here. You can configure them in your CRM profile. Disconnect: /stop
botReplies.stopped: Notifications are turned off. You can reconnect in your CRM profile.
botReplies.notLinked: This chat is not connected to the CRM.
botReplies.whoami: You are connected as {name}. Notifications arrive automatically. Disconnect: /stop
botReplies.hello: This is the {app} bot. To connect, open “Profile → Connect Telegram” in the CRM.
botReplies.callbackNotLinked: This chat is not linked to the CRM — nothing was done.
botReplies.callbackUnknown: This button is out of date.
botReplies.callbackForbidden: Not enough rights — nothing was done.
botReplies.callbackFailed: The action failed. Please open the CRM.

inAppAlwaysOn: CRM notifications (with sound) and browser push notifications always arrive and cannot be turned off. Here you choose what to duplicate to Telegram.
